description: This file defines the LeaveOverlapParams class in the OrangeHRM Leave module. It extends LeaveParameterObject and provides methods related to leave overlap parameter handling, including deliberately throwing exceptions for certain get methods to indicate they are not supported.

classes.name: LeaveOverlapParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object for leave overlap parameters, extending LeaveParameterObject, with methods returning exceptions for unsupported operations.

methods.name: getLeaveType
methods.description: Returns the leave type, but currently throws a LogicException indicating the operation is not allowed.

methods.name: setLeaveType
methods.description: Sets the leave type. Currently does nothing.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns the comment, but currently throws a LogicException indicating the operation is not allowed.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets the comment. Currently does nothing.

methods.name: getLogicException
methods.description: Private method that returns a new LogicException indicating the operation is not supported for this class.
